name: CalloutFormat
description: Contains properties and methods that apply to line callouts.
remarks: Use the Callout property of the Shape object to return a CalloutFormat object.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
With myDocument.Shapes(3).Callout
 .Accent = True
 .Angle = msoCalloutAngle30
 .Border = False
 .PresetDrop msoCalloutDropTop
 .Type = msoCalloutThree
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Accent
properties.description: Allows the user to place a vertical accent bar to separate the callout text from the callout line. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Angle
properties.description: Returns or sets the angle of the callout line. If the callout line contains more than one line segment, this property returns or sets the angle of the segment that is farthest from the callout text box. Read/write MsoCalloutAngleType.

properties.name: AutoAttach
properties.description: True if the place where the callout line attaches to the callout text box changes depending on whether the origin of the callout line (where the callout points to) is to the left or right of the callout text box. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: AutoLength
properties.description: Applies only to callouts whose lines consist of more than one segment (MsoCalloutType types msoCalloutThree and msoCalloutFour). Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that represents the visibility options for the border of the object.

properties.name: Drop
properties.description: For callouts with an explicitly set drop value, this property returns the vertical distance (in points) from the edge of the text bounding box to the place where the callout line attaches to the text box. Read-only Single.

properties.name: DropType
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates where the callout line attaches to the callout text box. Read-only MsoCalloutDropType.

properties.name: Gap
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal distance (in points) between the end of the callout line and the text bounding box. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Returns a Single value that represents the length (in points) of the first segment of the callout line (the segment attached to the text callout box).

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoCalloutType value that represents the callout format type.

methods.name: AutomaticLength
methods.description: Specifies that the first segment of the callout line (the segment attached to the text callout box) be scaled automatically when the callout is moved.

methods.name: CustomDrop
methods.description: Sets the vertical distance (in points) from the edge of the text bounding box to the place where the callout line attaches to the text box.

methods.name: CustomLength
methods.description: Specifies that the first segment of the callout line (the segment attached to the text callout box) retain a fixed length whenever the callout is moved.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The length of the first segment of the callout, in points.

methods.name: PresetDrop
methods.description: Specifies whether the callout line attaches to the top, bottom, or center of the callout text box, or whether it attaches at a point that's a specified distance from the top or bottom of the text box.

parameters.name: DropType
parameters.description: The starting position of the callout line relative to the text bounding box.
